$comment: A9-LOCATION exceptions for build/ci/Test-VendorPackageUniqueness.ps1.
14 §1.1 🔒: 'No driver or vendor SDK anywhere outside an adapter.' That rule is
written about the SHIPPED dependency graph - the client and the server - and it
is the right rule for every project that ends up in an APK or a container.
M8 hit the case it does not describe: a BUILD-TIME tool under tools/ that ships
in no artifact at all. 15 §B4 mandates a seven-step image post-processing
pipeline (background removal, quantise, resample, PNG-32 export). That cannot be
written without an imaging library, .NET ships none cross-platform in-box
(System.Drawing.Common is Windows-only from net7.0), and SixLabors.ImageSharp was
rejected at the M8 kickoff because its Split License charges above a revenue
threshold. So a vendor imaging package in a build-time tool is unavoidable, and
reading 14 §1.1 literally forbids something that must exist.
WHY THIS FILE AND NOT non-vendor-packages.json. Allow-listing SkiaSharp there
would have declared it 'not a vendor SDK', which is false, and would have
removed it from the A9-UNIQUE check as well - so a second project could take it
with the gate green. An entry here is narrower: the package stays a VENDOR
package, A9-UNIQUE still governs it in full, and only its permitted LOCATION
moves, to one named project. Both teeth stay in.
WHAT BELONGS HERE: a vendor package in a build-time tool under tools/ that is
referenced by no shipped project. WHAT DOES NOT: anything reachable from
src/SlayIdleRepeat.Client or src/SlayIdleRepeat.Server, and anything that talks
to a database, cache, object store, payment or ad network, push service,
analytics or telemetry backend. Those live in exactly one adapter, as before.
🔒 EVERY ENTRY MUST EXPIRE BY ITSELF (steering S4). An entry whose (id, project)
pair is not in the scan fails the build as a stale exception - the same shape as
rule 5 in build/ci/test-suites.json. Removing a package or renaming a project
forces its exception to go with it; it cannot sit here pre-armed for whatever
lands on that name next.
⚠️ AWAITING RATIFICATION. Added by the M8 conductor at the wave-3 integration
(2026-08-13) to resolve a gate that had been red since M8-06 merged. It is an
interpretation of 14 §1.1's SCOPE, not a change to its intent, but it is the
product owner's to confirm - it belongs with X-07, and the M8 milestone review
should either ratify it or amend 14 §1.1 to state the build-time carve-out
directly.
